sources.name: European Commission — eAmbrosia
sources.scope: Registered wine PDOs and PGIs in eAmbrosia. Foreign entries cover EU registration, not the complete domestic register.

sources.name: Wine Australia
sources.scope: Australian GIs listed in the register, including regions, subregions, zones and broader indications.

sources.name: US Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau
sources.scope: Established AVAs. State and county appellations are not included in this register.

sources.name: Intellectual Property Office of New Zealand
sources.scope: Domestic registered wine GIs, including enduring indications; pending applications excluded.

sources.name: Sakpatenti — National Intellectual Property Center of Georgia
sources.scope: Registered wine appellations in the state register. Mineral waters, cheeses, spirits and applications excluded.

sources.name: Chile — Servicio Agrícola y Ganadero
sources.scope: Regions, subregions, zones and areas named in Article 1 of Decreto 464, plus Secano Interior. Supplementary labels and all Secano Interior commune combinations are not separate entries.

sources.name: Argentina — Instituto Nacional de Vitivinicultura
sources.scope: IGs and DOCs in the INV published list. Same-name designations in different provinces and IG/DOC registrations are kept separate.

sources.name: South African Wine Industry Information & Systems
sources.scope: Wine of Origin production areas in the February 2026 list, including geographical units, regions, subregions, districts and wards. English/Afrikaans aliases retained.

sources.name: Japan — National Tax Agency
sources.scope: Domestic wine GIs in the NTA list. Sake, spirits and foreign indications excluded.

sources.name: British Columbia — Wines of Marked Quality Regulation
sources.scope: Geographical indications established by section 56, including British Columbia and its regional subdivisions.

sources.name: Ontario Wine Appellation Authority
sources.scope: Ontario appellations listed by the regulator, including regional appellations and subappellations. This does not establish complete Canadian coverage.

sources.name: Switzerland — Federal Office for Agriculture
sources.scope: All 63 AOC/KUB/DOC names in the federal list of 1 January 2026. Intercantonal Vully and Zürichsee counted once; land wines and supplementary place names excluded.

sources.name: Québec — Conseil des appellations réservées et des termes valorisants
sources.scope: Recognised wine IGPs in Québec. Cider, spirits and non-wine appellations excluded.

sources.name: Brazil — INPI (IP)
sources.scope: Granted Brazilian wine and sparkling-wine indications. Foreign registrations and non-wine products excluded; separate IP and DO registrations retained.

sources.name: Brazil — INPI (DO)
sources.scope: Granted Brazilian wine and sparkling-wine indications. Foreign registrations and non-wine products excluded; separate IP and DO registrations retained.

sources.name: United Kingdom — Defra protected wine names
sources.scope: Additional UK-registered wine names from the United Kingdom, Albania, Serbia, Moldova, Ukraine and Liechtenstein. Existing EU records retained where names match. Foreign protection is not a complete audit of each domestic register.

sources.name: Council of the European Union — Montenegro accession document
sources.scope: Thirteen names confirmed as already protected nationally in Montenegro in the December 2025 accession document. This is not a claim of completed EU registration.

sources.name: India — Geographical Indications Registry
sources.scope: Nashik Valley Wine, registered GI 123. This individual record is not a complete audit of all Indian wine-producing areas.
